title: Psalm 99 (The Lord God Reigns)
lyrics_original: The LORD God reigns in majesty;
Supreme in Zion is the LORD,
All nations, praise His name with awe:
The mighty King loves justice well,
O magnify the LORD our God,
In worship at His footstool bow:
When priests and prophets called on God,
His cloudy pillar led them on,
Tho’ sending judgments for their sins,
Exalt the LORD and worship Him:

bible_verses.english: Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned between the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
Yahweh reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, Almighty King, You reign in glorious majesty and unfailing holiness. When the world around me shakes, help me to fix my eyes on Your unshakeable throne. Teach my heart to bow in true reverence and awe, trusting in Your justice and love. May my life bring praise to Your holy name today and always. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When life feels unpredictable, Psalm 99 anchors our hearts in a glorious truth: the Lord God reigns supreme over all creation. Our God is not a distant ruler, but a Holy King who sits enthroned in majesty and passionately loves justice. As we sing His praise, we are invited to bow our hearts in reverent awe, trusting His perfect sovereignty. May His holy presence fill us with peace today, knowing that the One who commands the heavens holds our lives securely in His hands.
